# Create: Numismatics | Recipes
This datapack adds crafting recipes for coins from the **Create Numismatics** mod for Minecraft 1.20.1, making it easier to obtain currency and use it in the in-game economy without admin involvement.



## (RU) Create: Numismatics | Рецепты

Этот датапак добавляет крафт монет из мода Create Numismatics для Minecraft 1.20.1.
